prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Aluminium (알루미늄) itself — the sovereign of the Aluminium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: aluminium: a bright satin-silver metal so light it almost floats, the most common metal in the Earth's crust yet locked so tightly in clay and rust-red bauxite that it was once rarer than gold, laid only before an emperor's honoured guests, until electricity set it free; it shields itself in an invisible oxide skin that can be dyed soft anodized pastel colours; the skeleton of airships and aircraft, the humble can and kitchen foil of everyone; ruby and sapphire are nothing but coloured aluminium oxide; light, bright, cheerful and unpretentious. Palette: bright satin aluminium silver, soft anodized pastel blue and rose, bauxite clay red, a clear sapphire-blue accent.

World (fixed): a sky-harbour kingdom that draws silver out of clay: hills of rust-red bauxite, a lightning tower whose bolts strike molten clay into gleaming silver ingots, docks where airships with feather-light silver skeletons float up into the clouds, a court whose windows are set with ruby and sapphire. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette; 2) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 3) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 4) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 5) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 6) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 7) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): bright satin aluminium silver, soft anodized pastel blue and rose, bauxite clay red, a clear sapphire-blue accent.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): bright satin aluminium-silver hair with soft anodized pastel blue and rose tints. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Al) and atomic number (13) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed chosen design to draw:
Choose silhouette 2: a high-collared mage robe with wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle. Give her a soft diamond face, violet-blue eyes, short wavy satin-silver hair softly tinted pastel blue and rose, gentle curious smile. The robe is built as overlapping thin hammered-silver oxide petals around a clay-red lining, with open shoulders, a deep lined neckline and a high slit. Her empty hands rest apart as she turns toward the viewer beside the kingdom's lightning-smelting tower; blue sky and bright mineral terraces. Whole figure, eye-level.
